description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets associated with researchers from different locations over the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, and the vertical axis represents “Number of datasets,” labeled on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10⁰ to 10² with tick labels at intervals of 10⁰ and 10¹. Each year contains a grouped set of bars representing datasets from different researcher locations, indicated by color: blue for “Other,” orange for “USA,” green for “IN,” red for “UK,” purple for “IT,” brown for “DE.” For each year, the height of each colored bar indicates the number of datasets from that location; for example, in 2012, the “USA” bar reaches approximately 2 datasets, while the “UK” bar reaches approximately 8 datasets. In 2022, the “USA” bar reaches approximately 15 datasets, and the “UK” bar reaches approximately 90 datasets. The bars are grouped by year and location, with no apparent sorting order within each year. A light blue shaded area extends horizontally across the chart, beginning at the top of the bars and ending at the zero line on the vertical axis.
